messages:
sam_support: FYI ACME Inc flagged — invoice INV-78321 unpaid. They submitted PO PO-9921 and requested Net60. Stripe shows card decline (code: card_declined). Can we approve net terms or offer temp credit?

maya_billing: Can you post the invoice link + last 4 of card? Need VAT ID too.

sam_support: Invoice: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-78321
Stripe log snippet:
```
charge failed: 402, code=card_declined, decline_code=insufficient_funds
payment_method: pm_1JxABC...
```
Customer VAT: GB999888777
They attached PO PDF, says wire transfer preferred.

lucas_account_mgr: Acme is growth SaaS — asking Net60 to align with their AR. PO included. They want upstream approval; offering to take Net45? Could propose 1% 10 days discount.

erin_finance: Policy is Net30 standard. Net60 requires CFO sign-off for new customers. Need credit check + contract amendment. Postpone automated dunning for 7 days? We can issue temporary credit hold of up to $10k while we verify.

maya_billing: If they provide signed PO + VAT cert, we can move invoice to 'Pending PO' and switch payment terms to 'Wire' manually. Need GL code and sales rep approval for credit note.

sam_support: Customer says they will wire but can't until Net60 approved — circular. They asked for invoice to be held from collection. They're asking us to accept PO as guarantee.

erin_finance: Not comfortable taking PO as sole guarantee. Suggest credit hold + require signed contract amendment for Net60. I'll escalate to CFO @nina_finance. @nina_finance can you review?

nina_finance: Looking. Send me the customer's D&B score and AR contact. Also what's their ARR with us? If ARR>200k and low risk, we can do Net45 as one-off.

lucas_account_mgr: ARR is ~320k. D&B score 78. Sales agrees to Net45 with 30k temporary credit. I'll get signed addendum and PO-stamped invoice.

maya_billing: I'll prepare a pro-forma for wire with VAT breakdown and mark invoice 'On hold - pending PO'. Please attach signed addendum and I'll route to accounting for the credit hold.

sam_support: Customer OK with Net45 and will sign the addendum today. I'll upload PDF when received. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 

billing-bot: Payment attempt queued — awaiting wire confirmation.

sam_support: Upload done: https://files.redwood.ai/attachments/po-9921-signed.pdf

erin_finance: Received. Nina approved Net45 one-off. Maya, you can process the credit hold and change terms. Confirm when done.

maya_billing: Done — invoice status moved to 'Pending PO / Net45' and temporary credit of $30,000 applied. Notified customer and disabled automatic dunning. Closing thread.

sam_support: Great, closing. Note: update AR playbook with Net45 exception steps.
